entries.msgstr: Fires a shot that damages the target and all enemy vehicles within a 35 m radius.
Fires a shot that restores hit points by stealing them from the target and nearby enemy vehicles within a 35 m radius.
Fires a shot that stuns the target and all enemy vehicles within a 35 m radius.
Protects against any damage (except ramming, drowning, and impact) for 10 seconds.
Your next successful shot causes double damage.
Tactical Devices help you fight more effectively in Last Stand battles, complete Stages, and earn valuable rewards. To equip them, click one of the Tactical Device slots.
Gives a chance to deal increased damage to an enemy vehicle.
Increases rate of fire / reloads magazine.
Restores some hit points after destroying an enemy vehicle.
Temporarily stops enemies from targeting your vehicle, restores hit points, repairs modules, extinguishes fire, removes the stun effect, and treats all injured crew members.
Temporarily increases your vehicle's mobility after taking damage from an enemy vehicle.
Restores hit points, extinguishes fire, removes the stun effect, and repairs damaged modules.
Repairs damaged modules, extinguishes fire, removes the stun effect, and restores some hit points to allied vehicles within its radius.
Tactical Devices can be equipped in special slots to help you fight more effectively in Last Stand battles, complete Stages, and earn valuable rewards.
